hero.headline: Someone at this table is lying.
hero.subheadline: Mafia is a social deduction game for 6–11 players, right in your browser. Get a secret role, argue with your friends, vote someone out — or get fooled trying.
hero.howToPlayLink: New here? Learn how to play

items.q: How many players do we need?
items.a: Six to eleven. Roles are dealt to fit your table, so a small group and a full house both get a proper game.
Yes — everyone signs up first. Then one person creates a room and the rest join with the invite link or room code.
Send them your invite link or room code. They join from their browser, and the host lets them in. No installs, no downloads.

items.q: Do I need a camera or microphone?
items.a: They run right in the browser, and you can toggle either before joining. Mafia is a talking game though — mic on is strongly advised.

items.q: What happens when I get eliminated?
items.a: You stay and watch. The fallen gather in the graveyard strip while the living keep arguing — perfect for backseat suspecting.

items.q: How long does a game take?
items.a: Rounds of night, day, and voting repeat until one side wins. Most games wrap up in minutes, not hours.
